name: mt_bench_polish
description:
MT-Bench Polish
	


  


This repo contains the Polish translation for the popular MT-Bench dataset.
This dataset was translated first by GPT-4o, and then corrected by a Polish speaker, Daria Magiera, who is both a Polish native and an employee of Lightblue.
This is part of three language datasets that we have added to the MT-Bench benchmark:

Indonesian
Polish
Vietnamese

This dataset was uploaded by Peter Devine (ptrdvn)
reputation: MT-Bench (and its language-specific variants) is a widely referenced human-evaluation benchmark for multilingual LLM performance and is used to compare instruction-following quality across languages.
